subject: REMEDIATION_AUTHORITY_BASIS
basis_statement: F001: Public TrainingContext and KnowledgeBoundary must not retain a mutable caller-owned learning_map_reference. Equality with the canonical reference is insufficient authority. Store an independent canonical immutable module-owned value. Reject or normalize malformed, duck-typed, equality-spoofed, and noncanonical direct-constructor reference input without retaining caller ownership. Direct-constructor regression must prove source mutation cannot alter the stored reference. F003: Public TrainingAttempt direct construction must preserve the authorized initial-submission contract. Store a canonical immutable TrainingContext and the authorized immutable submitted-analysis representation for user_analysis, without retaining caller-owned mutable context or user_analysis aliases. Require image_reference null, initial revision only, initial status only, and id and created_at that satisfy existing TrainingAttempt creation semantics. Preserve existing user_confidence rules and the F002 Stage-consistency invariant; add direct-constructor regression coverage. Scope exclusions: no revision workflow, persistence, screenshot support, Evaluation behavior, LearningState behavior, generalized validator engine, new shared abstraction, or new business scope.
